payload.text: Check that the tap's CI runs brew style and brew audit --strict again (hv's ISSUE:0004 ruling 3). Released when: the tap's formula is published by devbin 0.1.20 or later, at 0.1.9's post-cut. The vendored 0.1.20 carries the fix (devbin 0322: lib/cmd/formula:436 writes the manifest list one element a line), but the live formula 130e87d was rendered by 0.1.19, and the tap's test.yml still turns style and audit off. Then: turn them back on in test.yml and see the tap's CI green.
